alertRuleNeedsSink: Create or enable a webhook sink before creating an alert rule.
alertDiscardMessage: Your unsaved alert changes will be lost if you switch items.
alertRuleCreateError: Unable to create alert rule. Your draft is still available.
alertRuleThresholdInvalid: Threshold must be within the allowed range for this condition.
alertRuleWindowInvalid: Window must be between 1 and 2,592,000 seconds.
alertRuleGraceInvalid: Grace period must be between 0 and 2,592,000 seconds.
alertRuleReminderInvalid: Reminder interval must be between 0 and 2,592,000 seconds.
alertSinkCreateError: Unable to create webhook sink. Your draft is still available.
alertSecretReferenceHelp: Enter a secret reference for each custom header. Secret values are never accepted or shown.
alertDuplicateDeliveryHelp: Delivery retries can cause the receiver to get the same webhook more than once if an acknowledgement is lost.
draftRestoredReviewRequired: Your draft is restored on the current revision. Review it before saving or enabling.
publicWarning: Anyone who can reach this instance can read and manage it.
welcome: Keep work visible. Keep operations in control.
foundation: This workspace is ready for your tenant. Execution and monitoring views will become available as their services are enabled.
unavailable: This view is not yet connected to operational data.
stale: Settings changed. Reload before saving again.
invalidZone: Choose a valid IANA time zone.
localPreferences: Your language and time zone are saved on this device.
vaultSettingsHelp: Use the deployment-installed provider. Provider identity and credentials are managed by the deployment.
vaultReferenceOnly: This page accepts public provider options and secret references only. It never accepts or reveals secret values.
outboundSettingsHelp: Scope job and alert destinations with host, port, and private network allowlists.
allowedHostsHelp: One host per line. A wildcard is limited to *.example.test subdomains.
privateCidrsHelp: One private CIDR per line. Loopback, link-local, and metadata ranges stay denied.
hardDeniedNotice: Deployment hard denials cannot be changed here. Private destinations require both a listed host and an explicit bounded CIDR.
stalePreserve: The job changed. Your unsaved edits are preserved; reload before saving.
staleDraftPreserved: This job changed. Your draft is preserved; reload the current job before retrying.
draftMustBeReviewed: Review this disabled copy before enabling it.
templateRequired: Choose a template and enter a job name.
confirmDisable: Disable this job? New starts stop and held retries are released.
confirmArchive: Archive this job? Future starts and retries stop.
remoteOutcome: The remote outcome may remain unknown.
schedulePaused: Schedule paused. Manual runs remain available and paused occurrences are not replayed.
viewerHistory: Execution history is available with read-only access.
cronHelp: Times are evaluated in the selected zone. Nonexistent local occurrences are skipped; repeated local occurrences run once at the earlier UTC instant.
cronFieldsHelp: Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Day-of-month and day-of-week use AND semantics.
offsetHelp: Choose the explicit offset for this local time, for example -04:00 or -05:00 during a repeated hour.
actionError: Unable to apply this job action.
effectiveStateMayLag: Effective scheduler state may be catching up.
gracefulStopRequested: Graceful stop requested. Local termination follows worker acknowledgement.
stopError: Stop request failed. The execution may still be running remotely.
stopHelp: Graceful stop requests cooperation. Force stop terminates the local child process.
confirmDeleteSchedule: This removes future scheduled runs. The job remains available for manual runs.
scheduleDeleted: Schedule deleted. The job remains available for manual runs.
scheduleDeleteFailed: The saved schedule is still present. The draft is preserved; retry saving after resolving the schedule removal.
scheduleRemovalUnconfirmed: Schedule removal could not be confirmed. The job may still run on its schedule; pause or disable it and verify before enabling manually.
scheduleStillPresent: The saved schedule is still present and may continue to run.
scheduleDraftUnconfirmed: This schedule draft has not been confirmed on the server. Save and verify it before enabling.
timeoutHelp: Enter a positive number of seconds or select No timeout. Zero does not mean unlimited. A job without a timeout still occupies capacity until it completes, is stopped, or is interrupted.
overlapHelp: Queue keeps accepted work in order; Skip drops a new overlapping occurrence; Allow can run overlapping attempts.
missedPolicyHelp: Skip omits late work, Coalesce emits one latest missed occurrence, and Catch up uses the configured count and age bounds.
dynamicExampleOnly: Preview values are examples. Execution values are resolved when the job runs.
sqlProcedureHelp: Enter only the procedure name. Add its parameters below.
sqlQueryHelp: Enter the complete SQL statement using @parameter placeholders. Add matching parameter names, types, and values below.
sqlSelectExample: Example: SELECT * FROM dbo.Items WHERE CreatedAt >= @FromDate
sqlNullHelp: Send a database NULL value for this parameter.
sqlTimeoutWarning: No SQL command timeout is set. This command can wait indefinitely unless the job timeout or a cancellation stops it.
sqlTimeoutLimitedByJob: The job timeout limits this command.
sqlDecimalHelp: Precision is the total number of digits. Scale is the number of digits after the decimal point.
sqlLegacyDynamicHelp: This saved template version does not support dynamic values. Upgrade the template version to configure them.
sqlExecutionKeyHelp: The same per-execution idempotency key is supplied on retries. A new execution gets a new key.
sqlSizeHelp: For character and binary types, use -1 only when the database column is MAX.
previewSampleContext: Example values for sample occurrence {sampleAtUtc}. Generated execution IDs and idempotency keys are examples only.
runNowReferenceDatePrompt: Request date in {timeZoneId}. Leave blank to use today when the request is accepted.
runNowReferenceDateUnavailable: This template version does not support a reference date override.
useScheduleTimeZone: Use the schedule time zone for dynamic values
